bulk_create_prospects.description: Add up to 100 prospects at once from a list of rows, such as the rows of an earlier step. Each row needs an email and may have first_name, last_name, company, title, phone, list_name, tags, custom_fields and the other prospect fields. Says which were added and which already existed.
bulk_create_prospects.name: bulk_create_prospects

parameters.description: The prospects, as a list of rows with an email each.
parameters.name: prospects

already_existing.description: How many were already in Klenty

results.description: What Klenty said about each prospect

success.description: True once Klenty has done it
